issue_text: sum_range(a, b) is meant to sum the integers from a to b INCLUSIVE, but it excludes b: sum_range(1, 3) returns 3 instead of 6.
reason: minimal correct fix (b -> b+1) AND adds a keystone test; nothing out of scope
diff:
--- a/lib/range.py
+++ b/lib/range.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def sum_range(a, b):
-    return sum(range(a, b))
+    return sum(range(a, b + 1))
--- a/tests/test_range.py
+++ b/tests/test_range.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
 from lib.range import sum_range
 
+
+def test_inclusive():
+    assert sum_range(1, 3) == 6
